title: 第2章 恐怖如斯的进阶之路！
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
此刻的林雲亲身的感受到体内奔涌而起的一股巨大能量，禁不住咆哮一声，发出一阵惊天巨吼。
“嘿，还真没想到呀，之前我的阴阳五行功可是距离第五层都还要不少的时间的，这一日不到的功夫，竟然直接冲破了第六重！”
想不到现在只不过练习了不到一日的时间，竟然在黑化后三千倍增速的加持之下，等同于之前三年的努力。
阴阳五行功轻而易举的冲破了第五重顺利的进入了第六重，林雲也因此顺利的进入了三阶武者的境界。
虽说三阶武者只不过是武道的起点，但在普通的人的眼里也是难以匹敌的狠人了。
就目前的段位，林雲徒手空拳也可轻轻松松的击倒数个青壮男子，龙行镖局的所有镖师，若是想要随镖队出行押镖之人，必须是三阶武者及以上的的水平才可以随行！
他自然也希望能够成为与他父亲林天朔一样的一阶武者境界，乃至绝对的超越他。
这时的林雲也拍了拍落在身上的雪花，很近来到了屋内，脱去外衣倒头就睡了。
由于他父亲林天朔近些日子一直都在外走镖，镖局的后院之内也没什么人来打扰他。
院子之中，林雲时而挥拳，时而踢腿，时而手肘猛击，沉醉于每天独自一人练功的喜悦之中。
content_en:
At this moment, Lin Yun personally felt a huge surge of energy in his body, and couldn't help roaring, letting out a shocking roar.
"Hey, I really didn't expect that my Yin Yang Five Elements Kung Fu was still a long way from reaching the fifth level. In less than a day, I actually broke through to the sixth level!"
Unexpectedly, I have only practiced for less than a day, but with the blessing of the three thousand times growth rate after blackening, it is equivalent to the previous three years of hard work.
The Yin Yang Five Elements Kung Fu easily broke through the fifth level and successfully entered the sixth level. Lin Yun also successfully entered the realm of a third-level warrior.
Although third-level warriors are only the starting point of martial arts, in the eyes of ordinary people, they are also ruthless people who are difficult to match.
At his current rank, Lin Yun can easily knock down several young and strong men with his bare hands. All the escort masters of the Longxing Escort Bureau must be third-level warriors and above if they want to accompany the escort team to escort them!
He naturally hopes to become the same first-level warrior as his father Lin Tianshuo, or even surpass him absolutely.
At this time, Lin Yun also patted the snowflakes that fell on his body, came inside the house, took off his coat and fell asleep.
Since his father Lin Tianshuo has been out traveling as a escort in recent days, no one bothered him in the backyard of the escort agency.
In the yard, Lin Yun sometimes punched, sometimes kicked, sometimes hit with his elbow, intoxicated in the joy of practicing alone every day.
